title: Объясни Ситуацию (Речь)
description: Объясни, почему люди выглядят так, используя Present Perfect Continuous. Пример перед тобой. Теперь составь свои предложения, используя подсказки ниже и успей рассказать их за 60 сек.

conditions.label: Present Perfect Continuous (has/have been + V-ing)
conditions.hint: He has been coding all night.

conditions.label: Глаголы из ситуаций
conditions.hint: coding, planting flowers, running in the rain

conditions.label: Результат: почему так выглядят
conditions.hint: He is tired because he has been coding all night.

sentences: He looks exhausted because he has been coding all night.
She is dirty and happy because she has been planting flowers in the school garden since morning.
They are soaked and cold because they have been running in the rain for half an hour.
The reporter is breathless because she has been talking non-stop to witnesses after the accident.
We are tired but satisfied because we have been working on this project together all week.
